core.headline: New three-bedroom semi-detached house, Kings Hill, West Malling
core.listing:
Plot 47 is a new three-bedroom semi-detached house at Orchard Rise, Kings Hill, West Malling. Completion is expected in spring 2027. The property benefits from an air source heat pump with underfloor heating to the ground floor and an EV charging point with two allocated parking spaces.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). The first floor provides three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside, there is a turfed rear garden with a patio. The property has two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

Kings Hill is located approximately 2 miles from West Malling station. The property is offered with a 10-year NHBC warranty and no onward chain. A developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring is available for reservations by 30 November 2026.

Fixed Price £410,000. A reservation fee of £1,500 applies, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Freehold, with an estate charge of £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: brick and block under a tiled roof. The final EPC will be issued on completion.

Images show the show home; specification may differ. Exterior image is computer-generated (CGI) and indicative only.
core.summary: New semi-detached house completing spring 2027 with air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging point and two allocated parking spaces. Freehold with 10-year NHBC warranty and no onward chain.
